settings.headline: What helps us reply quickly
settings.body:
• What the organization does and who the site is for
  • What is not working today
  • Any deadline we should know about
  • Whether you want to host it yourself or have us run it

We send back a few questions and, if it looks like a fit, a short call and a written scope with a fixed price.
settings.side: Monday to Thursday, 9:00 am to 5:30 pm ET. Fridays are meeting-free, so expect replies on Monday.
